verdict.rationale: Asking for in-product AI insights is a fair question for an error-monitoring SaaS, but the evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside BugSnag. Error grouping, correlated events and automatic assignment are rule-based features, not AI. The MCP server serves external agents and belongs to a different story, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
